en: Yeah, yer definitely the grasshopper in that scenario.
Oh, I got an email.
Whaaat!? What's this all of a sudden!?
My mother is telling me to come back home.
Did somethin' happen?
She says she's setting up an arranged marriage for me. She set a date for a meeting and everything.
An arranged marriage? You're gonna get married?
I am not! Geez! What is she thinking, doing all this without even telling me!?
What're ya gonna do? Turn it down?
I'm going to call my parents after this and give them a piece of my mind.
Your parents are probably just worried that yer driftin' in life. Don't tell 'em off too hard.
But don't you think arranging a marriage out of nowhere is going way too far?
Well, do what ya have to.
Thanks for taking me out today. It's nice to get out for a walk once in a while! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Sure. To tell ya the truth, I was a little nervous walkin' along the main roads like that.
Well, please come see me at the club again sometime!
Hey, Akiyama-san!
Oh, you're not alone?
Whoops. I guess not.
If there's somethin' ya gotta do, go ahead and get it done first.
Sorry about this...
I've really been wantin' to see ya! I wanted to chat with you some more. Mind if we go wander around for a bit?
Not at all. Let's get going.
The view is really terrific here. I can see why the people of Osaka love this river.
Don't you think it's remarkable, civilization and nature existing side by side like this? The river has seen the whole city grow around it.
What're ya talkin' about? This is a manmade canal. It ain't a natural river.
That's what the "bori" in Sotenbori means. Some guy built it hundreds a' years ago.
Oh, okay.
But anyhow, I heard they cultivate pearls here in order to keep the water clean. Apparently the shellfish purify the water.
Maybe ya could dive in and fetch me a pearl!
Wow. They really planned out every detail in making this river, didn't they?
Hehe! Today was super fun, Akiyama-san! I'm much obliged to ya!
Same to you. I had a great time. I never would have expected you to invite me out on a date.
Did I inconvenience ya?
Not in the least. I blew off work and came running to see you.
Hahaha! *cough*
*cough* Nghah!
Whoa. Hey, are you okay?
*cough* It's yer fault, Akiyama-san, for sayin' weird things. Make sure ya get your work done!
Yes, ma'am.
I'm gonna head home now. See ya!
Oh, Shinada-san!
Oh? And who might this person be?
If you have something you need to do, please go ahead and take care of that first.
Ahaha. Sorry about this.
I've been looking forward to seeing you! I thought we could talk a bit more. Would you mind walking with me?
Sure! Let's go.
This neighborhood has changed so much.
Yeah. This Ferris wheel wasn't here when I first came to Nagoya.
You know, the office building my father worked at when I was in high school was around here.
Oh wow, really? Where does he work now?
Now, he, ah...
Several years ago, the office was relocated to somewhere else. It's no longer in Kineicho.
I see. I'm glad my job doesn't do the whole transferring thing. Though I do wish I could travel to other cities on business!
Hehe! You're quite fond of your job, aren't you, Shinada-san? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I sure am! It may not be what I dreamed of doing when I was a kid, but it's kind of a dream come true in a totally different way.
Dreams, you say? I somehow doubt my own dream is ever going to come true.
Shion-chan?
*click*
Huh? What was that?
Did something happen?
Hey, you! What're you doing!?
Damn. What in the world was that about?
Who was that just now?
I don't know. Nobody I know, I don't think. Did you know him, Shion-chan?
No, I didn't recognize him.
Hmm. Maybe he was just taking photos of the scenery, and when I snapped at him, he got spooked and tucked tail.
I had a great time! Thank you for taking me out today!
Hey, anytime you want!
I am looking forward to seeing you at the club again!
Um... Who's that?
Oh, yeah.
If you've got something to do, come back after you've finished things up.
That's alright! I've been hoping to see you. There was stuff I wanted to talk to you about. Let's go hang out for a bit!
I've actually never been up there before. I've always wanted to, though.
The Millennium Tower? The view from the rooftop is amazing, especially at night.
You've been up there, Kiryu-san? Wow!
Yeah. And you can, too. If you want to go to the top that badly, you should just go.
I know, it's just always been a matter of poor timing. Whenever I tried to go, some sort of accident had happened and it was closed to the public.
Heh. I'm sure it's okay now. You should try to go again.
Oh hey, it's Aimi-chan.
You know her?
She works at the club. She started a little after I did.
So you have seniority over her.
Well, yeah, but⑬ Wait, is that one of our customers with her?
Looks like they're out on a date.
Darn, she's really good at nabbing clients. If I don't up my game, she's going to outrank me soon.
Don't stress over it. You're already on your way up. Just do it at your own pace.
Thanks for coming out with me today.
Sure. I'll take you out whenever you like.
See you at the club!
Sir, thanks to you, business is booming once again!
Nah, it's all thanks to the top-class girls we got, from all over the country.
But they're just here temporarily. We need to make sure we can keep ourselves running even after they're gone.
Yes, about that!
Our new girl has finally finished her training and is ready for work in the club!
Oh, hey, really?
Yessir! Not only is she a real looker, she's smart and a gifted conversationalist.
To top it all off, she's super motivated, too! It's like she was born to be a hostess!
Sounds great. Her training sure took a lot of time, though.
Yes, she just happens to have a rather... difficult personality. That's all.
Meaning what, exactly?
Oh, never you mind that! Once she's out there with actual customers, I'm sure she'll be just fine!
Hmm. If you say so.
Is everything okay, sir? You seem worried still.
(I hope nothing bad happens.)
Kiryu-san, I hate to do this to you, but I have one more thing I need to ask of you.
Can you be a client for our new girl and see if she's really fit to be the face of my club? No, of all Kamurocho?
What? Why me?
Why indeed, sir? I assure you she's ready.
I need more than that. Any girl can chat and drink with clients. If that's all we offer, we're sunk.
I want to change the very idea of what both men and women think of when they hear the words "cabaret club."
Sir, you're not making much sense right now.
Kiryu-san, you're the only one who knows Kamurocho well enough to know if this girl is suited to be our star.
I get what you're going for here, but I'm not sure now is the best time.
That's a good point. And what would dear little Haruka-chan think if she knew you were messing around in a cabaret club at a time like this?
Akiyama, you'd better not⑬
I just thought you'd be on board with this, since you've been a regular at our club. But never mind. Forget I said anything.
Hey, not a word about any of this to Haruka, you hear me?
Of course not. We always ensure our customers' privacy.
Then again, if you're not our customer...
Ouch, sir. That's playing dirty.
Fine, fine. I'll go to your club and ask for this new girl of yours, okay?
All right! That's what I like to hear. I'll go ahead and put her on the clock. I owe you one, Kiryu-san!
I'll inform the adult entertainment info booths! Please visit an info booth before you visit. They'll hook you up!
Akiyama, I brought a hostess from Fukuoka.
Hiya! I'm Riku! Nice to meet ya! I've never been to Tokyo before. I'm all sortsa nervous!
Oh, I like her! That accent of hers is adorable. She's sure to be a big hit at our club.
Hehe, you sure know how to pick 'em, Kiryu-san!
Well, you know me.
Next time you come by Elise, your visit's on the house.
And welcome aboard, young lady.
Thank ya! I'm rarin' to go!
Hey, Akiyama. I brought ya a hostess from up in Sapporo.
I'm Kaguya. It's so nice to meet you.
Whoo-ee! She's got a body that won't quit!
Not bad, Saejima-san. Not bad at all.
Not bad? That's all ya got to say? I can take her back to Sapporo, ya know.
No, no, she's fine! Honest! Thank you!
And you, miss. It's lovely to meet you. Let me know if you need anything.
Well, a place to stay near the club would be greatly appreciated.
This is Elise, my club.
Wooow, this place is so nice! I think I made the right choice comin' here.
Right? Well, I'm really depending on you.
Now I just gotta get used to how ya Tokyo folk talk an' all that.
Akiyama-san, I've brought a hostess from Nagoya.
I'm Shion. Good to meet you, sir.
Well, well, well! Isn't she stunning?
Damn, Shinada-san! How'd you manage to nab a babe like her?
Hey, no need to be so rude about it, man. My charm and good looks are magic with the ladies.
Well, your charm makes me want to hire you as a talent scout for our club.
Now then, nice to meet you, my dear.
I can't wait to see what the men in Tokyo are like. This is going to be quite fun!
You should make nice with hostesses in other cities and scout them for our club, sir.
Well, Kiryu-san's got Hakata, Saejima-san's got Sapporo, I've got Osaka, and Shinada-san's got Nagoya covered. Hopefully we'll find some winners.
Slowly but surely, business is starting to pick up! Keep up the good work in wooing girls from around the country!
I could still use about three more girls on staff. We got a long ways to go.
The club's looking real good, sir! The locals have been coming by much more often than they used to.
Great! Just gotta find more girls.
Every day brings a load of new customers! We're one of the hottest clubs in town now!
We're almost where we need to be. There should be just one city left, I think.
I see it's dead as usual here.
How about you make nice with hostesses in other cities, and scout them for our club, sir?
Yeah, yeah, I know.
(Popular hostesses from other cities, huh? Wish I knew someone who could point me in the right direction.)
(Popular hostesses from other cities, huh? I should ask folks over at New Serena.)
Oh, it's you, sir.
Hey, Yuiko-chan. You getting the hang of running the club yet?
To be frank, it's not going all that great, sir. We've been losing a lot of clients lately.
I mean, just look! It's totally dead in here!
Yeah, this isn't looking good. Any idea what the problem is?
Honestly, Kamurocho just isn't popular right now. Roppongi and Ginza are all the rage.
And once we lose our customers to another part of the city, it's difficult to get them back.
Sounds like a tough situation to fix.
Also, we just don't have very good girls. The ones who were even the slightest bit popular all got snatched away by better clubs.
Wait, what? And you just let that happen?
What was I supposed to do? I can only pay them so much, and the girls want to go where they have more clients to pick from.
Damn. Well, I assume you're looking for new girls to be part of our lineup, right?
Of course, sir! It's just that Kamurocho is sorta dullsville these days, so finding the right girls isn't as easy as it used to be.
So you haven't found anyone at all?
I did find one girl! She's a real diamond in the rough, this one. I'm sure she'll be a big asset for us.
But she's still in training, is the thing. I've been very hands-on with her, but she's not ready for primetime just yet.
I see. So what you're telling me is that our current lineup of girls sucks.
Basically, yes.
Well, damn. I can't scour the town to find girls if there aren't even any around.
Actually, sir, about that. I have an idea.
Well, if scouting around Kamurocho isn't going to get us anywhere, maybe you could go to a different city and look around there?
Haha, come on! That's just...
Well, maybe you're right. That might be our best and only option.
We need girls who are ready to go ASAP! And preferably ones who are already doing good business for their clubs.
Alright. What other cities did you have in mind?
All the big cities! <Color:255,200,200,255>Fukuoka, Sapporo, Osaka, Nagoya<Color:Default>. Places like that.
Mmm. I hear you. Still, poaching popular girls from other clubs is easier said than done.
Well, sure. If you just go into the club and offer them a new job, the staff's gonna throw you out right then and there.
